mo_ta_cong_viec:
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Team Lead, you are responsible for leading an engineering team to deliver scalable, high-quality, and reliable solutions aligned with playCONNECT’s product and technical goals. You combine strong technical expertise with people leadership, ensuring your team operates efficiently, collaborates effectively, and continuously improves both engineering quality and delivery practices.
You will act as the bridge between engineering, product, and other stakeholders (DevOps, Games, Loyalty teams, Data,…), translating requirements & priorities into actionable execution plans while fostering a healthy, high-performing, and AI-augmented engineering culture.
This role requires a balance of technical leadership, delivery ownership, mentoring, and strategic thinking to ensure your team can sustainably deliver impactful products and platform capabilities.
 
RESPONSIBILITIES
Technical leadership and Execution – Own the technical execution of your team by translating product requirements into clear engineering plans, technical designs, and implementation strategies. Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with engineering standards and long-term platform architecture. Review and validate Technical Design Documents and provide technical guidance throughout the development lifecycle.
Sprint Delivery & Agile Execution – Lead sprint planning, estimation, prioritization, execution tracking, and delivery coordination to ensure predictable and high-quality releases. Remove blockers proactively, manage delivery risks, and continuously improve team efficiency and Agile processes.
Stakeholder Alignment & Expectation Management – Act as the primary technical liaison between engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. Communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly while managing expectations around scope, timelines, and feasibility. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Designers, QA, and other engineering teams.
AI-Augmented Engineering Culture – Drive the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and tools, including coding assistants, automated documentation, and productivity tooling. Encourage innovation and continuous learning while ensuring sustainable engineering practices and developer well-being.
Team Health & Career Growth – Support the growth and success of team members through mentoring, coaching, feedback, and career development discussions. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and psychologically safe team culture while helping resolve interpersonal or delivery-related challenges.
Technical Strategy Alignment – Ensure alignment between architectural decisions, engineering priorities, and business objectives. Partner with Tech Leads and Engineering Management to balance technical excellence, scalability, speed of execution, and product impact.
Documentation Integrity – Maintain high standards for technical documentation, onboarding materials, architecture diagrams, and operational processes. Promote knowledge sharing and ensure technical information remains accurate, accessible, and up to date.
Engineering Quality & Continuous Improvement - Promote engineering best practices including code quality, testing, observability, security, and performance optimization. Identify areas for process improvement and lead initiatives that improve team productivity, reliability, and operational excellence.
yeu_cau:
QUALIFICATIONS
Must have:
5+ years in software engineering, with 1+ years actively leading, mentoring, and growing engineering teams across the full technology stack.
Proven ability to build high-performing team cultures, balance hands-on technical guidance with people management, and support engineers through career growth and skill development.
Fluent English (written and verbal) with strong interpersonal skills to manage cross-functional stakeholders, translate business goals for the team, and advocate for engineering needs.
Track record of driving delivery in fast-paced product environments while fostering psychological safety, resolving interpersonal conflicts, and keeping cross-functional teams aligned.
Broad expertise in modern frontend and backend architectures (e.g., .NET Core, Node.js, React, Vue, Angular, or equivalent modern ecosystems) to guide architectural decisions, manage tech debt, and uphold operational excellence.
Strong problem-solving skills to help teams navigate technical risks, maintain high engineering standards, and reliably scale high-traffic consumer applications.
Ability to rally the team around long-term product goals, translate big-picture feature vision into actionable engineering roadmaps, and foster continuous innovation within the team.
Nice to have:
Experience in gaming, loyalty, rewards, or consumer-facing platforms.
Experience managing distributed or international engineering teams.
Familiarity with APIs, SDKs, cloud infrastructure, and platform integration challenges.
Experience implementing AI-assisted development workflows and engineering productivity tooling.
Passion for mentoring and building strong engineering cultures.
Additional Notes:
You may be expected to complete a test as part of the interviewing procedure.

Top 10 global leaders in the social gaming sector
Global talented members and a thriving workplace
Desirable benefit package for you and your family

Global Collaboration: Work directly with diverse international teams from Hong Kong, Singapore, Israel, Serbia, the US, and more.
People‑centered Culture: Where individual effort, shared dedication, and true teamwork come together to craft games of outstanding creativity, aesthetic value, and entertainment quality.
Growth & Learning: Unlock unlimited growth opportunities through English classes, an online learning platform, specialized technical training led by global experts, and the opportunity to have hands-on experience with game products reaching up to 100 million players worldwide.
Comprehensive Healthcare: Receive Bao Viet Premium healthcare coverage of up to 1.2 billion VND/person/year for yourself, plus attractive coverage for all your dependents.
Insurance & PIT (Personal Income Tax): Receive 100% salary during probation, with full Social, Health, and Unemployment Insurance from day one. All compulsory insurance is fully covered by the company — you only contribute Personal Income Tax.
Reward & Recognition: 13-month salary/year; performance-based bonus; discretionary bonus; attractive employee referral bonus program.
Flexible work time: Work Monday to Friday with two remote days (Tuesday and Wednesday). No attendance tracking — we focus on performance management rather than time management.
Annual & Sick Leave: Annual leave of 15 days in the 1st year, 17 days in the 2nd year, and 20 days from the 3rd year onwards, plus 5 days of sick leave per year.
Perks & Comforts: Fresh, delicious, free meals served daily; high-end workstation with laptop and monitors provided; and an equipment allowance of 4,500,000 VND to choose your preferred keyboard, mouse, headset, and more.
Engagement: Enjoy charity initiatives, team-building, company trips, year-round events, and company-supported clubs like board games, badminton, soccer, and ping pong.
Other benefits: Financial support for sickness or funeral (up to 2,000,000 VND/person), and for birthdays, marriage, childbirth, or public holidays (up to 500,000 VND/person).
